env_id.description: The Apigee environment group associated with the Apigee environment, in the format organizations/{{org_name}}/environments/{{env_name}}.
env_id.rationale: Identifies the Apigee environment, and the correct value is organisation-specific.

fault_x_paths.description: List of XPath expressions that specify the XML elements or attributes that the debug mask applies to for fault messages.
fault_x_paths.rationale: Controls which sensitive XML data is masked in fault-message debug output.

namespaces.rationale: Defines application-specific namespace prefixes and URI mappings used to evaluate XPath expressions against a team's XML payload structures. Because these mappings depend on each API proxy's application logic and XML schema, a platform-level policy cannot meaningfully constrain them, making this unsuitable as a generic security policy target.

request_json_paths.description: List of JSONPath expressions that specify the JSON elements or attributes that the debug mask applies to for request messages.
request_json_paths.rationale: Controls which sensitive JSON data is masked in request-message debug output.

request_x_paths.description: List of XPath expressions that specify the XML elements or attributes that the debug mask applies to for request messages.
request_x_paths.rationale: Controls which sensitive XML data is masked in request-message debug output.

response_json_paths.description: List of JSONPath expressions that specify the JSON elements or attributes that the debug mask applies to for response messages.
response_json_paths.rationale: Controls which sensitive JSON data is masked in response-message debug output.

response_x_paths.description: List of XPath expressions that specify the XML elements or attributes that the debug mask applies to for response messages.
response_x_paths.rationale: Controls which sensitive XML data is masked in response-message debug output.

variables.description: List of variables that the debug mask applies to.
variables.rationale: Controls which sensitive flow variables are masked in debug output.
